product.title: Full-Day Lake Tahoe Circle Tour including Olympic Valley

description.text: Circle the full lake on a comfortable air-conditioned shuttle with a driver-guide. Stops include Palisades Tahoe, Emerald Bay State Park, Tahoe City, and Logan Shoals Vista Trail with commentary on Tahoe history and landmarks.

highlights: Full circumnavigation of Lake Tahoe by shuttle bus
Stops at Palisades Tahoe and Emerald Bay State Park
Logan Shoals Vista Trail and Tahoe City free time
Hotel pickup and drop-off at select South Shore hotels

start.description: Pickup from select South Shore hotels including Marriott Resorts, Golden Nugget Lake Tahoe, and Hilton Vacation Club on Ski Run Blvd starting at 8:00 AM.

end.description: Return to your original South Shore hotel pickup point.

product.itinerarySummary: Circle the full lake on a comfortable air-conditioned shuttle with a driver-guide.

itineraryItems.title: Palisades Tahoe
itineraryItems.description: Stop at the former Olympic Valley resort area with time to explore the village.

itineraryItems.title: Lake Tahoe
itineraryItems.description: Travel the lakeshore ring road with scenic viewpoints and guide commentary.

itineraryItems.title: Emerald Bay State Park
itineraryItems.description: Photo stop overlooking Emerald Bay and the surrounding alpine forest.

itineraryItems.title: Tahoe City
itineraryItems.description: Free time in Tahoe City to explore shops, the waterfront, or grab lunch.

itineraryItems.title: Logan Shoals Vista Trail
itineraryItems.description: Brief stop at a North Shore viewpoint above the lake.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Full-Day Lake Tahoe Circle Tour including Olympic Valley?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 7 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from at Lake Tahoe?
faqs.answer: Pickup from select South Shore hotels including Marriott Resorts, Golden Nugget Lake Tahoe, and Hilton Vacation Club on Ski Run Blvd starting at 8:00 AM.
